sources.title: Lotus Peak supply agreement
sources.text: Kestrel Works Pvt Ltd is a fictional company. This document is sample data. This agreement is between Kestrel Works Pvt Ltd (the Buyer) and Lotus Peak Technologies (vendor V-104, the Supplier). It starts on 1 October 2026. The Supplier is on probation with the Buyer until 31 March 2027. During probation the Buyer reviews delivery and quality every quarter, and may end probation early by written notice. The Supplier may deliver to the Buyer's Pune and Bengaluru offices only.
